title: Gondolier
summary: The gondolier is an unnamed man who acts as a gondolier in Venice, Italy. He has been knocked into the canal from his gondola by Lok Lambert on two separate occasions.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
The Gondolier was flung into the canal when Lok Lambert tried to escape from DeFoe's Suits and their Titans by jumping into a gondola. The gondolier, terrified by the sight of the Titans, later ran into DeFoe, telling him in a panick that monsters were in the canal. DeFoe used a Touchram and Simplemind spell on him to knock out the gondolier and make him forget this event.
[A Seeker Is Born]

Through a similar event, Lok Lambert and Den Fears knocked the gondolier into the canal when trying to escape from a group of the Blood Spiral's Silent Soldiers. When the gondolier resurfaced, he saw the Silent Soldiers use their magical powers, and he dived underwater again. [Boys Will Be Seekers]
